header: CN 104292137 A          权 利 要 求 书          2/2页

paragraphs.notes: Fragment. This is the tail of a claim that begins on the previous page (权利要求书 1/2页); no claim number is printed for it on this page. It is recorded under marker "2" only because the next numbered item on this page is claim 3 - the number itself is NOT printed here and was not read off this page. The first character 烷 is the second half of a solvent name broken across the page boundary (the preceding characters are on p02), so the fragment begins mid-word and the English is left correspondingly truncated.

paragraphs.zh: 3.根据权利要求1所述的三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤2)中2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯，无水三氯化铝和乙酰氯的摩尔配比为1:1-5:1-2，所述溶剂为二氯甲烷、氯仿或1,2-二氯乙烷。
paragraphs.en: 3. The synthesis process for the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 according to claim 1, characterised in that, in step 2) the molar ratio of 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and acetyl chloride is 1:1-5:1-2, and said solvent is dichloromethane, chloroform or 1,2-dichloroethane.
paragraphs.notes: 环磺草酮 is left untranslated in the en field because the page never gives a systematic name for it; the Chinese common name 环磺草酮 corresponds to tembotrione, but that identification comes from outside this page and is not printed on it. 摩尔配比为1:1-5:1-2 is ambiguous as printed: it most plausibly reads as three components in the ratio 1 : (1-5) : (1-2), i.e. two of the three terms are ranges, but the page does not disambiguate the hyphens from range dashes. 甲磺酰基 = methanesulfonyl/mesyl as written. See page-level note on comma width for the punctuation rendering.

paragraphs.zh: 4.根据权利要求1所述的三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤5)中2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-甲基苯甲酸甲酯与溴素反应的摩尔配比为1:1-1.5，所述的溶剂为四氯化碳，氯仿，二氯甲烷或1,2-二氯乙烷。
paragraphs.en: 4. The synthesis process for the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 according to claim 1, characterised in that, in step 5) the molar ratio for the reaction of methyl 2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-methylbenzoate with bromine is 1:1-1.5, and said solvent is carbon tetrachloride, chloroform, dichloromethane or 1,2-dichloroethane.
paragraphs.notes: 溴素 is the literal term for elemental bromine (Br2); translated as "bromine". The solvent list here is separated by commas, whereas the equivalent list in claim 3 is separated by the Chinese enumeration mark 、. Both marks are clearly present and clearly distinct on this page, so the inconsistency is in the original and has been preserved, not normalised.

paragraphs.zh: 5.根据权利要求1所述的三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤6)中2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯与三氟乙醇钠的摩尔配比为1:1-1.5，所述的溶剂为四氢呋喃，乙腈，二氯甲烷或甲苯。
paragraphs.en: 5. The synthesis process for the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 according to claim 1, characterised in that, in step 6) the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate to sodium trifluoroethoxide is 1:1-1.5, and said solvent is tetrahydrofuran, acetonitrile, dichloromethane or toluene.
paragraphs.notes: 三氟乙醇钠 translated literally as "sodium trifluoroethoxide" (the sodium salt of trifluoroethanol). The page writes 三氟乙醇钠 with no locants, i.e. it does not print "2,2,2-" here, although claim 6 does print 2,2,2- on the corresponding trifluoroethoxy group. Recorded as printed. 四氢呋喃 = tetrahydrofuran; the 呋喃 characters are legible and are not the corrupted forms seen from OCR.

paragraphs.zh: 6.根据权利要求1所述的三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤7)中2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、氯化亚砜和环己二酮的摩尔配比为1:1-5:1-3，所述碱为无机碱或有机碱。
paragraphs.en: 6. The synthesis process for the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 according to claim 1, characterised in that, in step 7) the molar ratio of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, thionyl chloride and cyclohexanedione is 1:1-5:1-3, and said base is an inorganic base or an organic base.
paragraphs.notes: 环己二酮 is printed WITHOUT a locant on this page - it is not written as 1,3-环己二酮. Recorded exactly as printed; the 1,3- assignment is not readable from this page and has not been supplied. 氯化亚砜 = thionyl chloride (SOCl2); the character is 砜 (石+风), verified at high magnification. The bracketed group is printed as -3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-, i.e. the (trifluoroethoxy)methyl group is attached at position 3, with the parentheses closing before 甲基. Molar ratio 1:1-5:1-3 carries the same range ambiguity as claim 3.

paragraphs.zh: 7.根据权利要求6所述的三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，所述的无机碱为碳酸钠，碳酸钾，氢氧化钠或氢氧化钾。
paragraphs.en: 7. The synthesis process for the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 according to claim 6, characterised in that said inorganic base is sodium carbonate, potassium carbonate, sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide.
paragraphs.notes: Depends on claim 6, not claim 1. List separated by commas rather than 、, as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 8.根据权利要求6所述的三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，所述的有机碱为吡啶或三乙胺。
paragraphs.en: 8. The synthesis process for the triketone herbicide 环磺草酮 according to claim 6, characterised in that said organic base is pyridine or triethylamine.
paragraphs.notes: Depends on claim 6, not claim 1. This is the last claim; claim numbering on this page ends at 8 and the remainder of the page below this line is blank.

discrepancies.what: No chemical structures are drawn anywhere on this page; every molecule is given by Chinese name only, so no drawing-versus-prose cross-check is possible for this page.
discrepancies.text_says: all species named in prose: 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯, 2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-甲基苯甲酸甲酯, 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯, 2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸, 环己二酮

discrepancies.what: Ring numbering of the step-2 substrate and the step-5 substrate differs between claims: the mesyl group is at position 6 in claim 3 but at position 4 in claim 4. Both names are read as printed and neither has been altered. This cannot be resolved from this page because the intervening steps 3) and 4) are described on pages this pass does not see.
discrepancies.text_says: claim 3: 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯 (mesyl at 6); claim 4: 2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-甲基苯甲酸甲酯 (mesyl at 4)

discrepancies.what: The dependent claims on this page cover only steps 2), 5), 6) and 7). Steps 3) and 4) have no dependent claim on this page. If they are claimed at all it must be on the previous claims page.
discrepancies.text_says: claim 3 → 步骤2), claim 4 → 步骤5), claim 5 → 步骤6), claim 6 → 步骤7)

discrepancies.what: Trifluoroethyl locants are printed inconsistently between claims: claim 5 writes 三氟乙醇钠 with no locants while claim 6 writes (2,2,2-三氟乙氧基). Preserved as printed rather than normalised.
discrepancies.text_says: claim 5: 三氟乙醇钠; claim 6: (2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基

discrepancies.what: Solvent and reagent lists are separated inconsistently: claim 3 and claim 6 use the Chinese enumeration mark 、 while claims 4, 5 and 7 use commas. Both marks are unambiguously distinguishable on this page, so this is an inconsistency in the printed original and has been preserved.
discrepancies.text_says: claim 3: 二氯甲烷、氯仿或1,2-二氯乙烷; claim 4: 四氯化碳，氯仿，二氯甲烷或1,2-二氯乙烷

notes: Page 3 of 9 = 权利要求书 2/2页, the second and final page of the claims. It contains the tail of the preceding claim plus claims 3 through 8 in full, and nothing else; everything below the last line of claim 8 (roughly the bottom 60% of the page) is blank apart from the centred page number 3. There are no drawings, no schemes and no tables on this page. Every Chinese character was verified at high magnification and nothing on the page was illegible. ONE TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTION, flagged because it is a judgement call and not a direct reading: this scan's typesetting inserts inter-script spacing around Latin runs, which makes half-width and full-width comma glyphs very hard to separate at this resolution. Sentence-level and list-level commas have therefore been written as the full-width Chinese comma ，and commas inside numeric locants and ratios (1,2-二氯乙烷; 2,2,2-三氟乙氧基) have been written half-width. The Chinese enumeration mark 、and the full stop 。 ARE unambiguously distinguishable in the scan and are transcribed as read. Parentheses in 步骤2)/(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基) are transcribed half-width; the opening paren after a hyphen is unambiguously half-width, and the closing paren shows symmetric inter-script gaps consistent with half-width, but a full-width ）cannot be excluded with total certainty. No chemistry was inferred anywhere: 环己二酮 is recorded without the 1,3- locant because none is printed, and 环磺草酮 is left as the Chinese common name because the page gives no systematic name for it.
